hints.identity.kind: e.g. interior — a kitchen; exterior — a back alley; a stage set
hints.identity.scale: how big it reads — a cupboard, a room, a hall, a street
hints.identity.era_and_place: when and where it belongs — a 1970s London bedsit
hints.identity.register: what it feels like in a few words — cramped, grand, clinical
hints.space.layout: the plan — where the walls, doors and windows are relative to each other
hints.space.walls: material, colour, finish, what hangs on them
hints.space.ceiling: height, material, anything hanging from it
hints.space.openings: every door and window — where it is, what is seen through it
hints.space.fixed_furniture: what is built in or too big to move — the counter, the bed, the bar
hints.space.materials: the three or four surfaces that dominate
hints.space.condition: new, worn, derelict — and how it shows
hints.dressing.props.placement: where it sits, and against what
hints.dressing.props.detail: colour, make, wear — what a render must get right
hints.dressing.signage_text: any legible text in the space, verbatim — or none
hints.dressing.clutter: how full the space is, honestly — bare, lived-in, hoarded
hints.lighting.sources: every practical and every window — where it is, what it throws
hints.lighting.states.name: e.g. day, night, dusk, practicals only
hints.lighting.states.description: what the light does in this state — direction, colour, contrast
hints.lighting.colour_temperature: warm, cool, mixed — and which source is which
hints.palette.dominant: the two or three colours that fill the frame
hints.palette.textures: what the surfaces feel like to the eye
hints.rendering.lens: the focal lengths it holds together at — a small room wants wide
hints.rendering.vantages.name: e.g. wide from the door, reverse to the window, over the counter
hints.rendering.vantages.description: where the camera stands, what it sees, what is at frame edge
hints.consistency.must: one cue every render must show — the checklist, one line each
hints.consistency.never: what must be absent, or must never change
hints.consistency.drift_modes.fix: what to state in the prompt instead
hints.text_identity_block: ~50-70 words: only what a text-only engine cannot infer — the plan, the fixed furniture, the light sources, the dominant materials and colours
